description: Booking platforms to look a business up on when their own website cannot answer the question. Answers the single most valuable fact about a prospect: are they already booking online? A business FOUND on one of these is a WORSE prospect — they have an incumbent — so a false positive here costs a good lead, and a false negative costs a wasted phone call.
verificationNote: The per-business searchUrlTemplate values are DEAD and kept only for the paid-search fallback, which does not use them. The first real run proved they cannot work: these platforms publish town directories, not per-business search URLs, so every request returned 404. The `listing` block below is the live path — read one town's directory once and answer the question for every lead in it. Those URL shapes come from indexed pages (booksy.com/en-us/s/hair-salon/15889_miami, vagaro.com/listings/hair-salon/miami--fl) but the pagination and town-id patterns are still UNVERIFIED, and a crawl that cannot finish is recorded as failed rather than as an empty town.

matching.notes: Both conditions must hold. Salon names repeat constantly across a state — there are dozens of 'Hair Studio' listings in Florida alone — so a name match without a city match is not evidence of anything.
